text:
Mia: Heads up — noticed intermittent hangs in multi-node 8xA100 perf runs in eu-west-1. All-reduce stalls ~2-3x/day, jobs stuck at barrier.
Sam: Logs? dmesg / mlx5 errors?
Mia: paste: `dmesg | tail` -> `mlx5_core 0000:86:00.0: FW error recovery... ib_qp_create failed -110` and on NCCL side `unreachable peer, op timeout`.
Leo: Is this RoCE or TCP fallback? NCCL prints show it's trying IB.
Mia: We're forcing IB: NCCL_IB_ENABLE=1, NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0, NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_0. When it fails, jobs still show gpudirect enabled.
Anya: Can you run `ibv_devinfo -vv` and `ethtool -S eth0 | head`? Also check MTU, ECN settings on the switches.
Mia: Ran `ip link show eth0` -> `mtu 1500` on worker nodes. Switches recently rolled fw -> maybe defaulted MTU down.
Devon: If MTU mismatch, RoCE will fragment and hurt QP handshake. Try setting MTU 9000 across hosts and switch ports.
Sam: Also confirm driver/kernel: `modinfo mlx5_core` shows version 5.13.14; MLNX_OFED v5.4 applied last month.
Mia: Temporary workaround — forcing NCCL to fallback to TCP avoids the hang: `export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` but cost goes way up.
Infra-bot: NOTE: network team alerted. Logged ticket NET-4823 for possible port flaps on spine-3 in eu-west-1.
Leo: Another data point: `dmesg` shows `mlx5_core QP 0x2f moving to ERR state` then `qp 0x2f error -104`. That indicates reachability issues.
Anya: Check switch counters for RQ errors / RX drop due to MTU/TSO offload. Also confirm that PFC isn't misconfigured — RoCE needs lossless behaviour unless it's RoCEv2 with ECN and retries.
Mia: I ran `ethtool -k eth0` shows `tx-checksum-ip-generic: on` and `scatter-gather: on`. Try toggling GRO/TSO? Not ideal.
Devon: On similar incident last year, a combination of NIC firmware + jumbo frames mismatch caused QP resets. We rolled forward NIC FW and forced MTU 9000; stable after that.
Sam: Can we schedule a quick maintenance: set MTU 9000 on the worker NICs, bump switch port MTU, and monitor for 24h? Also collect pcap on one host during job to confirm fragmentation.
Mia: Will test tomorrow on a staging pool. Repro steps: run 8xA100 all-reduce job with NCCL_TESTS, set NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_0, and loop. If failures, capture dmesg + `ibv_devinfo -vv`.
Anya: If we still see flaps after MTU/firmware, check for bad optical transceivers on the path or mis-provisioned VLANs causing asymmetric routing.
Infra-bot: NET-4823 assigned to @Sam and @Anya. ETA for initial MTU change in staging: 2h.
Mia: thanks, will post results. :crossed_fingers:
Sam: thx — if staging green, let's plan rolling for prod with canary nodes.
